actors.description:
List of actors for which events should be delivered to this event subscription. Actors must be specified in the format `actorType:actorId`.
Wildcard Support: Use `<actorType>:*` to match all actors of a specific type (e.g., `camera:*` matches all cameras). Only full wildcards (`<actorType>:*`) are supported. Partial wildcards like `camera:123*` are not allowed. Only admin users can use wildcard actors.

types.description: List of event types of which events should be delivered to this event subscription.

DslCondition.description: A leaf filter condition that compares a single event data field against a value.

field.description: Event data field path in the format `schema.vN.fieldName` (e.g. `een.lprDetection.v1.plate`). The special virtual field `eventType` can be used to filter by event type.

op.description: Comparison operator. Range operators (`gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`) require numeric or date fields. `in` and `notIn` expect the value to be an array.

value.description: The value to compare against. Must match the field type (string, number, boolean). For `in` and `notIn`, provide an array of values.

DslFilter.description: Optional DSL filter for data-level event filtering. When provided, only events whose payload matches all specified conditions are delivered to the subscription. An empty object `{}` matches all events (no filtering applied). Boolean combination keys determine how conditions are evaluated: `and` requires ALL to match, `or` requires ANY to match, `not` requires NONE to match. Arrays may contain leaf conditions or nested DslFilter objects for recursive composition.

and.description: All conditions must match. Each element is a condition or nested filter.

or.description: At least one condition must match. Each element is a condition or nested filter.

not.description: None of the conditions must match. Each element is a condition or nested filter.

id.description:
Only events with this specific event type should be delivered to the event subscription. `GET /eventTypes`
can be used to get a list of all supported event types.
